title: comanthera vernonioides var. minor
intro: Comanthera vernonioides var. minor, commonly known as the Dwarf Button Flower, is a small, flowering plant species belonging to the family Eriocaulaceae. The Dwarf Button Flower has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and respiratory problems, due to its reported health benefits. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids. However, more research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety for human consumption.
